title: Post-evidence-infrastructure whole-codebase bug hunt
description: After the current exact-main attestation, affinity supervisor, retained-artifact replay, and Algorithm 4/5 benchmark-evidence hardening integrate, pause before accepting promotion measurements and perform a fresh independent hunt across the entire first-party tree. Recheck codec arithmetic and wire/profile invariants as well as benchmark isolation, provenance, replay, path binding, signal cleanup, concurrency, optional builds, and failure atomicity. File and fix every confirmed defect with a regression, then repeat the complete hunt from clean source until one full pass finds no new actionable bug.
acceptance_criteria: All current evidence-hardening dependencies are integrated and independently reviewed; production scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 plus exact-main comparison paths pass direct-oracle, boundary, strict GCC/Clang, focused sanitizer/concurrency and adversarial evidence-tamper gates; every confirmed finding has a child bug and regression; after the final fix, a fresh independent whole-tree repeat records zero new actionable bugs before any timing result is promoted.

title: Make affinity supervisor recovery and containment fail closed
description: Independent pre-commit review of tools/leopard2_affinity_supervisor.py found that report-write failure can skip restore; recovery skips failed/malformed records; direct-child descendants and SIGKILL launch windows can survive; new threads can inherit permanently restricted masks; ignored signals can hang; post-syscall TID reuse is accepted; journal durability lacks boot/PID namespace binding; no-op scans fsync at 40Hz; tests and README overstate guarantees; and the wrapper report is not bound into authoritative evidence. None of this code is integrated yet.
acceptance_criteria: Use a journaled gated launch with no unrecorded execution window; bounded signal escalation; child-session cleanup; exact-schema recovery that retries failed records and rejects uncertainty; boot/PID-namespace binding; successful directory durability before mutation; uniform/inferred creator policy or fail-closed handling for newcomers; post-syscall reuse invalidates evidence; restore is attempted despite journal-write errors; unchanged monitor scans do no I/O; explicit fake tests remain active under python -O; README is exact; an accepted supervisor report is machine-verified and bound into or explicitly required by authoritative ABBA evidence without weakening the zero-jiffy gate; independent rereview is CLEAN.

title: Close R=1 XOR path gap versus exact Leopard main
description: The latest isolated exact-main checkpoint leaves the legacy-high GF8 K=129,R=1 XOR encoder and one-loss decoder about 2.2-2.5% slower than exact Leopard main even after the dedicated R=1 path. Attribute public validation, pointer setup, direct XOR reduction, recovery, and tail costs; remove avoidable overhead without weakening API safety or wire identity.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned zero-sibling-work exact-main ABBA covers power-boundary K values, 64 B through 1 MiB, aligned and tail lengths, encode and one-loss decode; promoted code preserves byte identity, aliases, arbitrary GF8 lengths, scalar/SSSE3/AVX2/AVX512 determinism and ASan/UBSan; either target cells credibly improve at least 5% with no neighbor regression over 2%, or a measured non-promotable root cause is retained.
notes:
Candidate checkpoint c3b83e1 on agent/r1-coarse-xor-dd14f21 adds an internal coarse multi-source XOR op (scalar/SSSE3 groups of 4, AVX2/AVX512 groups of 6), deterministic measured gates (>=1 KiB; K>=5 scalar/SSSE3, K>=7 AVX2/AVX512), mature fallback for NEON/future backends, and safe one-item decode-batch validation shortcut. Release 84/84 and ASan+UBSan 84/84 passed before the final KAT/NEON-gate tightening; final targeted Release, ASan+UBSan, strict GCC, strict Clang each passed 6/6, and focused Clang TSan with the documented noninstrumented-libomp suppression passed 5/5. Strict Clang full 84/84 passed; strict GCC compiled clean and its only concurrent-suite lab oversubscription failure passed in isolation. Non-authoritative CPU14 directional exact-main K129/R1/4KiB: candidate ~6.0% faster encode and ~4.6% faster decode; authoritative committed-source power-boundary matrix and independent code review remain required before promotion/closure.
Authoritative attempt diagnostics on clean c3b83e1: 40-cell CPU14/30 run completed 480 children but failed the signed zero-sibling gate (56 nonidle jiffies/556s); failure bundle verified at .research/leopard2/exact-main-r1-c3b83e1-cpu14-20260718-v3/failure.json. CPU4/20 four-cell shards failed with 4-5 sibling jiffies/~53s; CPU6/22 two-cell shards failed with 1-2 sibling jiffies/~26s. No rejected timing is performance evidence. Root cause is the runner only repins itself while unrelated same-UID threads retain broad affinity; durable supervisor work is leopard-79h.16.5. Final post-review candidate must rerun with reversible same-user affinity isolation and exact restoration.

title: Profile and specialize FF8 small-payload metadata and control
description: Measure the non-payload cost of error-locator FWHT construction, locator-scale selection, transform schedule walking, atomic mode reads, and coefficient/function dispatch at 64-byte through 4-KiB shard sizes. Precompute or specialize only bounded metadata and control work; keep the static named-register payload circuit contract and thread-safe deterministic fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Cycle-attributed measurements separate scalar metadata/control from payload work for encode and decode; any selected cache or specialization is bounded, thread-safe, deterministic, preserves all count/loss/error paths, and changes no packed or native results. Small-payload benchmarks demonstrate a repeatable gain or the candidate is documented and rejected; allocation remains outside timed regions.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: High-value first hypothesis: SelectLocatorShift currently scans 255 shifts and all present/missing shards before payload decode. At 64 B to 4 KiB this scalar O(255*(k+r)) search can outweigh the XOR-circuit savings it selects. Measure it separately. Candidates include a payload-size break-even policy using a fixed verified shift, 255-bin log histograms with circular cost accumulation, and a bounded erasure-pattern cache; any shortcut must include the extra gates it causes in the end-to-end cost and preserve the multiplication-log-255 versus butterfly-sentinel-255 distinction.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Initial pinned CPU24 probe against immutable Release benchmark library (GCC 13.3, artifact bench SHA e556258d1c5d360f68a7afe353130ba895b9bb45c5be2f7f95fdc65ec06135f2) forced the exact auto-selected shift to isolate selection cost. k=8/r=2/max loss: selector adds about 1.55 us per decode; auto/forced ratios are 2.849 at 64 B, 2.064 at 1 KiB, 1.411 at 4 KiB, 1.021 at 64 KiB. k=128/r=128/max loss: about 43.9 us; ratios 3.747, 1.980, 1.300, 1.012. A second k=128/r=32 deterministic-pattern sweep (losses 1,4,16,32) selected nonzero shifts 68,97,145,117 but forced-selected versus forced-zero times differed by roughly -0.2% to +4.0% through 4 KiB while auto search added about 27-29 us, making auto/zero 3.70-3.02 at 64 B, 1.95-1.75 at 1 KiB, 1.26-1.22 at 4 KiB. At 64 KiB selected versus zero was generally within 1%; one low-iteration auto outlier requires ABBA repetition. This strongly motivates a size-aware fixed-shift path, but these probes are directional evidence only: promote only after ABBA, more patterns/seeds, 1 MiB, frequency controls, and post-derivative end-to-end correctness.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: The user requirement still favors the simplest legal constants, so first optimize exact selection rather than merely bypass it. Flip SelectLocatorShift from shift-outer to term-outer accumulation: keep uint16_t gates[255] and depths[255] (safe maxima are 256*23 and 256*17), and for each positive or inverse log add one contiguous 255-entry rotation of duplicated fixed gate/depth arrays. This removes per-shift pointer-presence tests, CanonicalLog/modulo branches, and enables baseline SIMD/vectorization while producing the identical gates/depth/lowest-shift tie break. Independently exhaust all synthetic log/sign histograms and real erasure patterns against the old selector. Only after that evaluate a size threshold if the exact vectorized selector still fails to amortize.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Exact selector prototype preserves the current all-255-shift objective and lowest-shift tie break while canonicalizing multiplication log 255 to log 0. It gathers at most 256 signed terms, accumulates duplicated rotated gate rows into bounded uint16 totals, finds the gate minimum, then evaluates depth only for gate-tied shifts. Differential prototype validation: 64,770 rotation cells, 510 signed one-term cases, 260,100 signed two-term cases, 5,000 random lists, and 106,750 valid FF8 shapes across baseline/AVX2/AVX512 builds. Portable selector medians improved 9.18x to 38.67x across k/r shapes (25.3x overall median). AVX2 accumulation adds 22-30% locally but will be considered only after portable end-to-end evidence; AVX512BW did not beat AVX2 and SSE2 register form spilled/regressed. Next action: integrate the portable exact algorithm with exhaustive production differential tests and measure end-to-end before adding ISA complexity.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Progress checkpoint e8d93dc/82e1e4c: exact locator-scale selection is implemented and retained without relaxing the simplest-circuit objective. It still minimizes total XOR2 gates, then dependency depth, then numeric shift over all 255 legal common scales; multiplier log 255 canonicalizes to log 0. Four generated 510-entry rotations replace shift-major scoring. The 256-term bounds are 5,888 gates and 4,352 depth, with no mutable cache or payload-data lookup and at most one selector call per decode. Independent coverage passed 261,129 differential cases, all 65,536 raw-log/shift rotation coordinates, the production k=254/r=2 256-term path, JSON/CSV schedule-corpus shifts, Release, Debug, ASan+UBSan portable-only, SIMD-disabled Release, Clang 18 Release, generator check, VS manifest, full Release 41/41 CTest, codegen audits, and a restarted clean bug-hunt pass. Pinned GCC 13.3 Release CPU24 C-A-A-C measurements used packed AVX2, ff8xor AVX-512 ZMM, four-buffer disabled, native planes, transposes/allocation/verification excluded. Selector speedups for 9/20/36/72/144/256 terms were 7.69x/13.29x/18.34x/22.31x/27.42x/32.13x. Native decode candidate/control time ratios across 20 schedules per size were 0.5014 at 1 KiB, 0.7565 at 4 KiB, 0.9965 at 64 KiB, and 1.0058 at 1 MiB; packed-decode-normalized ratios were 0.5005/0.7464/0.9827/0.9980. All 80 production shifts matched all four runs. Large payload is honestly neutral. Linux GCC and MinGW emit SSE2 loops with no normal calls; AArch64 GCC emits NEON. Candidate/control benchmark SHA-256 values are 873e5d8f7b3ac6f90d5ff762581e5d6c4d1c80cab9f4fc458d5694e1e8d92769 and 466e2142f11d3500a451b432eeef731cb5d0b994a4177b433768efbcac019021. Keep .45 in_progress: remaining acceptance work is phase/cycle attribution for locator FWHT construction, schedule walking, atomic mode reads, and coefficient/function dispatch for encode and decode at 64 B through 4 KiB, followed by bounded specialization or candid rejection. Host PMU access remains denied by perf_event_paranoid=4.

title: Harden balanced promotion manifest semantics and path attestation
description: Independent review rejected candidate 9fd237c because promotion conditions were inert metadata, validation accepted re-signed semantic weakening, exact-main/forced round-order metadata was conflated, main-compatible aligned tails lacked selected-mode exact-main artifacts, transform-group gating contradicted K/byte claims, interior T=128 K coverage was missing, and AUTO rejection cells did not attest the selected decode fallback. Correct the generator/runner/doc protocol before integrating or running timing.

notes: 2026-07-18 recurring review of balanced evidence head e86fcbd found two fail-closed gaps; integration is blocked pending fixes and rereview. First, each schema-v5 runtime dependency file identity was not bound to its raw loader_path, so a coherently re-signed swap could pass current/offline/scope validation. Second, cache inventories were only cross-compared between mutually editable summaries, so coherently truncating a cache index could pass. Fixes must add independent binding and adversarial regressions, then receive a clean rereview.

title: Prevent stale pinned sparse timings from acquiring fresh authority
description: The sparse crossover pinned wrapper measures sibling /proc/stat only around the current matrix invocation, but run_job may resume already-passed timing artifacts from an earlier contaminated or failed attempt. A later idle wrapper that executes no benchmark work can therefore elevate stale timings as authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned authority is impossible unless every timing observation was executed inside the same retained zero-nonidle-jiffy isolation interval. Either pinned mode rejects resume and reruns all jobs, or every invocation carries independently recomputable before/after sibling counters tied to the job; mutation tests reproduce and reject the stale-resume elevation; interrupted/non-authoritative artifacts remain resumable only without authority.
close_reason: Fresh pinned execution and stale-resume rejection implemented and fully gated.

It could accept AUTO generic or stale evidence as specialized promotion evidence.

notes: Fixed by f81567f: AUTO is structurally excluded; exact generic/materialized/tiled flag tuples and argv are authenticated; source/object/archive/executable/CMake/runtime identities come only from raw evidence; seven adversarial fixtures reject AUTO relabel, stale source/binary, sibling activity, argv rehash, sample tamper, and unsigned manifest. Root py_compile and CTest 2/2 pass. Historical artifact is explicitly non-promotable.

title: Define batch-count and plan-reuse dispatch hint semantics
description: Decide whether production dispatch may use exact batch count and expected plan reuse. The current API exposes only a multi-item boolean and no reuse hint. Specify a deterministic optional hint API or explicitly remove these keys from the dispatcher acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Decision documents API/ABI, default behavior, concurrency, determinism, and wire-profile independence; implementation and tests exist if hints are retained; normal calls never benchmark online.
notes: Decision implemented/documented 2026-07-18. No V1 ABI fields are added. Exact item_count remains an internal execution/scheduler fact; the decode selector exposes only evidence-backed single-versus-multiple class, and any batch path must fit the ordinary one-item per-item scratch allocation. Expected reuse stays an evidence/amortization dimension because setup is already complete and one immutable plan may be shared by callers with different reuse. A future hint requires an additive versioned plan-options/create API. Normal calls never benchmark online; profile/field/wire identity remains independent. Documentation: leopard2.h, Leopard2Dispatch.h, docs/leopard2_api.md, docs/leopard2_plan_gap_audit.md.
close_reason: Decision complete: no V1 reuse/exact-batch hint; documented ABI, scratch, determinism, concurrency and wire semantics with selector invariant coverage.

acceptance_criteria: Scratch and execution use one selector; actual selected path is observable in test/benchmark builds; overlap/order checks and threshold neighbor tests pass; profile/wire identity remains backend-independent; unsupported cells retain established fallback.

title: Wire sparse exact schedules into production encode or add encode plans
description: Audit found public production plumbing absent: production EncodeLayout reserves no schedule suffix, PrepareSparseEncodePlans is a no-op outside test hooks, and leo2_encode always passes an empty exact-plan view. If setup-inclusive call-local ABBA clears promotion gates, move bounded schedule storage into production scratch, compile the R-pointer mask after direct-path precedence, reuse across aligned/tail passes, fail closed to prefix, and dispatch only measured regions. If only prepared execution wins, keep ordinary AUTO prefix and implement a separately reviewed immutable leo2_encode_plan API rather than pretending setup amortization exists.
acceptance_criteria: Selected design has no hot-path allocation; exact scratch and one-byte-short/overflow/alias queries are correct; compilation happens before public writes and failure is atomic; arbitrary tails/GF16 padded odd, partial masks, batch and shared-codec concurrency pass; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2/direct-generator parity and re-decode recovery match; production selected-path tests lock thresholds; every promoted cell clears >=5% with neighbors above -2%, or a documented negative result leaves AUTO prefix.

title: Protect one-shot decode presence arrays from output and scratch overlap
description: Whole-codebase API alias audit found that leo2_decode() copies original_present/recovery_present into its reusable plan, then calls the public leo2_decode_plan_execute() path with protected_metadata=NULL. ValidateDecodeBuffers therefore protects only original/recovery/restored pointer arrays. A restored output shard or caller scratch span may overlap either const presence array; execution returns LEO2_SUCCESS and overwrites caller metadata despite the immutable setup contract. Repro observed scratch_presence_result=0 with mutated bytes and output_presence_result=0 with mutated bytes.
acceptance_criteria: One-shot decode preflight protects exact original_present[K] and recovery_present[R] spans against every writable restored shard, caller scratch, and pointer metadata according to existing whole-call atomic overlap policy; legal disjoint calls and reusable-plan execute remain unchanged; rejection returns LEO2_OVERLAP before writes and preserves all inputs/outputs; focused partial/duplicate/unaligned/boundary cases, allocation audit, ASan/UBSan and full API/alias suites pass.
close_reason: Presence metadata is now included in one-shot decode overlap preflight with focused Release and sanitizer regression evidence.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Fixed in root commit b62147b (worker source commit 6bef013): one-shot decode now protects both original_present[K] and recovery_present[R] as immutable metadata spans during preflight. Regression coverage includes strict partial scratch overlap at scratch+1, scratch/output overlap with either presence array, pointer-metadata overlap, legal disjoint execution, and atomic preservation. Worker Release API/alias/allocation suites passed 6/6 and Clang 18 ASan+UBSan passed 6/6; independent root focused Release gate passed 6/6 (api, public_api_contract, batch_aliasing, decode_plan_schedule, direct_encode, encode_concurrency).

title: Prove LeakSanitizer execution with an end-to-end canary
description: The v1 leak companion claims leak_sanitizer=true after proving ASan+UBSan and binding detect_leaks=1, but a strong __lsan_is_turned_off() target that deliberately leaks was accepted 2/2. Add a core-originated deliberate leak canary and require the expected LeakSanitizer diagnostic/nonzero outcome during create and every live audit/run verification; reject strong disable hooks as defense in depth; version the evidence contract and regenerate the full campaign.

close_reason: Closed by 3843db4, b7f3ed0, 732ac5e and 53dc1ef. Positive linked-core 12,345-byte canaries exit exactly 86; strong process-disable and selective-default-suppression attack targets are rejected; extra/indirect leak evidence, stale aliases and GCC builtin collisions have regressions. title: Separate hook-enabled tests from installable production library
description: LEO2_BUILD_TESTS defaults ON and currently compiles LEO2_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS into the same leopard target that benchmarks and install/export use. Test counters and hook scratch alter production behavior and public scratch queries (observed GF8 low 10896 vs 10752 bytes and high 8330 vs 8320 between tests-on/off).

title: Make test aligned allocation portable to MSVC

A seed-dependent leak could escape while docs call the combination complete.

A build that sanitizes fuzz_replay.cpp but links an unsanitized leopard library can pass, contrary to the documented codec-plus-executable coverage claim.

title: Bind sanitizer instrumentation identity in fuzz evidence
description: The v3 campaign labels ASan and UBSan active based only on requested environment and executable hashes. It accepts arbitrary executables, and its modeled Python helper can be audited as sanitizer-active despite carrying no sanitizer instrumentation. This makes the published sanitizer scope stronger than the evidence.

title: Bind LSAN_OPTIONS in sanitizer campaign and leak gate
description: The v3 fuzz campaign signs ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 but inherits ambient LSAN_OPTIONS through leopard2_lab before overlay. compiler-rt gives LSAN_OPTIONS precedence, so an ambient detect_leaks=1 can re-enable LeakSanitizer helper processes during parallel one-process evidence, while ambient detect_leaks=0 can silently disable the separate serial leak gate.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical parallel jobs bind both ASAN_OPTIONS and LSAN_OPTIONS with leak detection disabled; the separate serial leak command binds both with leak detection enabled; poisoned inherited environments cannot change either phase; schema/audit/self-tests bind the exact scope; real parallel and serial sanitizer gates pass.
close_reason: Canonical v4 parallel and v3 leak companion now bind ASAN_OPTIONS, LSAN_OPTIONS and UBSAN_OPTIONS explicitly, including detect_leaks and empty suppression paths. Poisoned-environment mutations pass self-tests; audited 60-job parallel and serial campaigns passed.

title: Integrate C1 sparse-input pruning into shortened encoder block IFFTs
description: The mature high/low encoder source-staging path now removes active-prefix copies, but a shortened or final partial inverse block still memset-initializes every inactive suffix shard because later regular layers read them. Compile immutable inverse C1 input-prefix schedules per codec/block shape and evaluate an allocation-free from-sources executor that treats shortened leaves as structural zeros without materializing the unused suffix. Preserve the regular staged path for dense blocks.
acceptance_criteria: GF8/GF16 high and low parity remains byte-identical to the padded legacy/direct oracle for every prefix length, arbitrary byte tails and all backends; null shortened pointers are never read; caller sources remain immutable; scratch writes/zeroed shards and memory traffic are counted; setup and execution are separate; deterministic dispatcher promotes only >=10% credible shortened-region wins with no >2% neighboring regression; Release, ASan/UBSan, TSan, fuzz and aliases pass.
close_reason: Candidate rejected by measured promotion gate; committed reproducible negative evidence, no AUTO/hot-path change, correctness and full Release gates pass.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Authoritative production-linked disposition integrated at 8082266. Candidate remained wire-correct across 25,407 plans/33,399 executions/99,581,751 bytes, but best mature-prefix gain was only 9.19% (<10% gate), median +0.316%, with GF8 AVX2 regressions 7.45% low and 8.57% high. title: Make the portable FF8 XOR binary baseline-ISA safe
description: The inherited CMake build applies -march=native to the whole library, so the nominal uint64_t Portable path and runtime dispatcher may contain build-host instructions before feature dispatch. Isolate packed and bitsliced SIMD code behind target-specific translation units or target attributes and compile public dispatch, scalar metadata, and portable kernels for an explicit baseline ISA. Preserve the optimized AVX2 and AVX-512 paths without making the experimental backend default.
acceptance_criteria: On x86-64, a strict opcode census proves dispatcher/portable objects contain no AVX, AVX2, AVX-512, GFNI, or other post-baseline instructions; runtime CPUID plus OSXSAVE/XGETBV gates every SIMD entry; forced Portable, SIMD128, AVX2, AVX-512VL, and AVX-512ZMM outputs remain byte-identical where supported. GCC and Clang Release/Debug/sanitizer builds pass, an AVX-disabled or x86-64-v1 build/run passes, unsupported forced modes fail safely, and native optimized benchmark performance is measured so portability is not purchased with an undisclosed fast-path regression.
close_reason: Baseline-ISA isolation, feature-safe dispatch, GCC/Clang/AVX-off/sanitizer matrices, adversarial flag census, and build-system regressions completed in bc40122/992a1ee.

comments.text: Checkpoint bc40122 isolates AVX2 in its own translation unit, constrains GCC/Clang x86-64 public dispatch and scalar initialization to the v1 baseline, adds CPUID plus OSXSAVE/XGETBV feature gates, and adds strict artifact opcode census tests. GCC Release 18/18, GCC Debug 16/16, AVX2/AVX512-disabled 17/17, focused GCC ASan/UBSan, and Clang 18 Release 18/18 passed. GCC strict assembly reported zero spills; Clang structural checks passed with reported butterfly spills. A precommit audit found isolated AVX2 had been disabled on MSVC x64; CMake now builds that source with /arch:AVX2 and retains the baseline dispatcher. Keep open pending unavailable MSVC execution and the remaining full Clang Debug/sanitizer matrix.

Baseline gateways/dispatcher compile for x86-64-v1 with individually probed negative feature flags; AVX2/AVX-512 remain isolated and CPUID+OSXSAVE/XGETBV gated. Adversarial Clang 18 Release global -mssse3 strict census passed with zero violations; Clang Debug ASan+UBSan passed 18/18 while all sanitizer-instrumented artifact gates/targets were correctly absent; GCC Debug passed 19/19 before the final custom-target-only regression; current GCC Release passed 23/23. title: Sanitizer campaign misclassifies LeakSanitizer exit helper as oversubscription
description: Clang 18 ASan+UBSan pruned-transform replays briefly fork a same-executable LeakSanitizer helper at clean process exit. The lab runtime monitor treats the two-process instant as forbidden workload oversubscription, sends SIGTERM, and non-deterministically marks otherwise passing seeds evidence_invalid. In a 56-job 8192-iteration campaign, all 28 API seeds passed but 21/28 pruned seeds were invalid; exact standalone reproduction passed while ps confirmed the exit helper.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve strict workload oversubscription detection while making the versioned sanitizer campaign deterministic under Clang LeakSanitizer; document whether leak checking is separated; add mutation/regression tests; an audited multi-seed ASan+UBSan campaign passes without hiding real sanitizer failures or inherited OpenMP oversubscription.

All nine child defects are closed; adversarial suppression/alias/stale/instrumentation mutations pass; integrated 60-seed campaigns audit cleanly with full iteration parity and resumability.

title: Decode-plan output alias mutates presence metadata before validation
description: leo2_decode_plan_create cleared plan_out before completing overlap validation when one presence bitmap was NULL. If plan_out aliased the non-NULL presence bitmap, the function mutated caller metadata and returned LEO2_INVALID_ARGUMENT instead of LEO2_OVERLAP.
acceptance_criteria: Validate both non-NULL presence spans and their overlap with plan_out before any output write; return LEO2_OVERLAP without mutation for original- and recovery-symmetric cases; add C ABI regressions; pass Release, ASan/UBSan, TSan, strict compiler, reduced-field, and a second independent clean audit pass.
notes: Independent whole-code hunt found and reproduced this defect. Fix integrated as commit 1e893ea (agent source a7ec446).
close_reason: Fixed in 1e893ea. Symmetric C ABI regressions verify LEO2_OVERLAP and byte-for-byte metadata preservation. Agent evidence: full Release 69/69; GCC ASan+UBSan 6/6; strict GCC 2/2; strict Clang ASan+UBSan 3/3; Clang TSan concurrency 3/3; reduced-field 1/1; GCC -fanalyzer clean; repeat audit found no further confirmed bugs.

title: Audit GF16 odd-byte rejection and padded-odd profile
description: An explicit native GF16 codec cannot universally support odd physical shard lengths while transmitting only B bytes: the trailing coordinate is projected to an alphabet of 256 values, and legal long GF16 parameter sets can exceed the MDS limit over that projected alphabet. The in-tree executable singular witness and decision leopard-79h.39.1 establish the constraint. Audit and harden the versioned GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 solution, which explicitly uses physical B+1; ensure native odd-GF16 requests reject deterministically, AUTO uses GF8 where legal, and docs/API make the physical/wire distinction unambiguous.
acceptance_criteria: Revalidate the projected-tail singular witness; all requested odd logical sizes (1,3,17,33,65,129,257,1025) pass encode and every valid erasure decode under scalar and every available SIMD backend using GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 with physical B+1, including direct oracle, parity rebuild, unaligned/guard and ASan+UBSan coverage. Native explicit GF16 odd physical lengths return the documented deterministic result, AUTO selects GF8 where legal, even-byte GF16 wire compatibility is unchanged, and no API path silently drops or synthesizes a transmitted byte.
notes:
2026-07-18 audit correction: initial observation K=17,R=2,B=129 returning LEO2_UNSUPPORTED was not by itself a correctness bug. Universal native odd-byte GF16 is mathematically impossible for the full supported count range without changing physical wire length. Scope revised to validate the existing versioned padded-odd solution and rejection contract; never weaken MDS behavior to satisfy the original wording.
Completed in commit bca2231 (review branch 9051fab) without adding a lossy native profile. Independent executable witness reconfirmed projected one-byte-tail singularity: low V1 K=2,R=256 rows 0/256 rank 14, collision message (0,1), full outputs (0,0x100). GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 B+1 hardening covers logical sizes 1,3,17,33,65,129,257,1025; high K3/R2 and low K2/R3; all 336 mixed loss masks; scalar direct parity oracle; physical+payload recovery; parity rebuild; unaligned guarded inputs; native/padded-core odd rejection; no-loss no-op; AUTO GF8. Counts: 165 payload cases, 27,544 direct symbols, 757 restored shards, 498 MDS basis recoveries, 336 patterns, 1,864 guard checks. Scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 byte-identical; strict GCC -Werror and Clang18 ASan+UBSan/leaks clean. Fresh-worktree structural test initially failed only because sse2neon was uninitialized; after submodule init every one of 69 Release tests passed individually.
close_reason: Padded-odd profile and deterministic native rejection hardened with proof, oracle, backend, guard, sanitizer, and full-suite evidence.

title: Bug hunt V: release-candidate whole-codebase audit
description: Conduct a final independent whole-codebase bug hunt after sparse-loss, parallel, and cross-platform prototypes and after all earlier bug-hunt gates. This is a correctness gate before the fully optimized performance comparison, not a benchmark task.
acceptance_criteria: From a clean checkout, review the complete diff and generated artifacts; run packed regression plus native and packed-equivalence encode/decode across all modes and edge cases, Release and Debug, practical ASan/UBSan, AVX-512-on/off builds, deterministic stale checks, strict assembly checks, benchmark JSON/CSV parsers, and unsupported-feature fallbacks. Fix every finding with a regression test and repeat the audit from the start until an entire pass finds no new known correctness or safety bug. Record exact commands, bugs fixed, unavailable tooling, and the final clean-pass evidence.

title: Bug hunt IV: layout, transpose, and direct plans

title: Fuse GF16 Algorithm 5 block IFFTs into syndrome accumulation

Scalar +0.39%, compact 64B +0.19%, fully-pruned K33/R17 +0.03%; larger-R neighbors K1000/R200 +0.74% tiled/-0.43% materialized and K4096/R512 -0.33%. The attempted exact-main runner failed closed because the reserved SMT sibling accrued non-idle work; verify-failure passes for .research/leopard2/gf16-alg5-vs-main-354274b-r2/failure.json and no ratios/CIs are claimed from it. Add a fused final inverse-transform layer/plan execution mode that accumulates directly, including sparse input masks and active-context scalar/SIMD backends, without making plan setup byte-dependent.

title: Fuse Algorithm 4 weighted block reduction into multiply-add
description: Every GF8/GF16 Algorithm 4 low-decoder variant currently scales each nonzero block shard in place with mul_mem_inplace and then makes a second xor_mem pass into the P-wide accumulator. The scaled block/tile is dead afterward. Replace this with one fixed-constant multiply-add pass into the accumulator wherever alias rules permit, preserving the derivative accumulator and exact active-parent coefficient.
acceptance_criteria: Prepared, planned, pruned and tiled Algorithm 4 variants use a single multiply-add pass for weighted nonzero blocks; direct/generic/small-field GF8/GF16 recovery matches for all loss patterns and tails; operation counters/KATs prove no separate scale+XOR pair; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2, Release, ASan/UBSan and concurrent plan tests pass; diagnostic Leopard2 attribution measures the change.
notes: 2026-07-18 implementation checkpoint: all GF8/GF16 prepared, planned/pruned, and tiled Algorithm 4 reductions now accumulate each dead transformed block with one muladd_mem pass instead of mul_mem_inplace plus xor_mem. The operation model retains identical arithmetic counts, records 248 fused vectors for K=8/R=248, and reduces the logical memory estimate by one read and one write per reduction vector; its source guard prevents reintroduction. Validation so far: focused Release 9/9, Clang ASan+UBSan 4/4, GCC strict low acceptance 1/1, operation model 338 checks. Full integrated gate follows after parallel backend checkpoints land.
close_reason: Completed in 88e61b3: all GF8/GF16 Algorithm4 prepared/planned/pruned/tiled reductions use one fixed multiply-add pass; source guard and 338-check model record the removed read/write, with focused Release, ASan+UBSan, strict and per-context backend coverage green. For later chunks, an accumulator-store variant on the final IFFT layer can XOR computed outputs directly into work[0..m), eliminating the temporary final stores, the temporary reread, and the standalone XorBuffers pass. Interior layers remain in temporary work, so the change is bounded and preserves the existing skew_base per chunk. Implement in-place and split source/destination aliases safely; quantify traffic separately for complete and partial chunks and avoid code-size duplication unless assembly proves worthwhile.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Detached read-only design at 3eb1778 identifies a bounded implementation order. This uses contiguous XOR kernels, saves exactly 3m/2 shard-byte traffic units (one third of that boundary), and can use VPTERNLOGD 0x96 in AVX512. Tracked partial chunks require 16 zero-presence variants/state snapshots; resume FFT at m/4, with all shifted tuples already in the generated corpus. Second, direct-load original pairs into the first IFFT layer: 127 reachable nonzero/nonsentinel skews (set checksum b14229cf...), exactly 16 live AVX2 YMM registers; use copy plus (1+M)*a for odd tail initially. Diagnostic gains are large for 64-byte GF8/GF16 and about 1-2% at 4 KiB, but exact-main encode remains slower in representative 4-64 KiB cells, so this bead remains open for transform/backend/work-pointer overhead and authoritative paired evidence.

Pair 10/26 passed setup but sibling 26 accrued 40 non-idle jiffies over 117.05s; surveyed quiet pair 6/22 passed a zero-activity precheck but sibling 22 accrued 9 non-idle jiffies over 114.06s. Exact-master ced2144 production-OFF ABBA exposes remaining encode gap despite final-layer fusion: GF8 K240/R16 4KiB center 0.967x with wide inconclusive CI; GF8 K128/R128 0.853x [0.769,0.947]; GF16 K1000/R200 0.894x [0.875,0.914] max-loss workload and 0.895x [0.889,0.901] one-loss workload. Ratios are master/Leopard2, so GF16 and balanced GF8 are credible regressions. This makes .38.5.3 first-layer input staging a priority before final comparison.
Authoritative detached a1fa5bf versus exact main 6e5725e completed as eight separately isolated three-round ABBA bundles, all digests exact and sibling non-idle=0. Encode ratios main/L2: XOR .975; GF8 K240/R16 1.172 one-loss and 1.194 full-loss; balanced 1.037; GF16 K200/R50 1.023; GF16 K1000/R200 .894/.895; GF16 K4096/R512 .949. Decode first-use ratios: .977, 2.212, 1.666, 1.049, 1.932, 3.383, 2.283, 2.022 respectively. Source staging child .3 closed; residual GF16 encode attribution/promotion continues as P0 child .4.

title: Add scalable allocation-free batch alias preflight metadata
description: The deterministic cross-item safety fix intentionally uses allocation-free O(B^2*(K+R)) pairwise sweeps because the existing batch ABI provides no batch-wide metadata workspace. This is correct but can dominate the plan's 1024+ stripe target. Add a size-queryable caller-owned preflight workspace, explicitly reserved context storage, immutable batch plan, or equivalent bounded design that flattens/sorts all readable/writable/metadata/scratch intervals in O(M log M) or better for M=B*(K+R), with no hot-path allocation. Preserve the current API as a correct fallback, shared immutable inputs, strict whole-batch atomic rejection, UINT32_MAX arithmetic checks, concurrent contexts, deterministic errors and true no-op semantics. Integrate with caller-executor/prewarm work rather than hiding allocation in the first batch call.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark B=1,8,64,1024 and larger feasible batches across small/large K,R; fast preflight is allocation-free after explicit setup, exact for partial/duplicate/metadata/scratch overlaps and unequal tails, ASan/UBSan/TSan clean, and does not regress small batches more than 2 percent or narrow existing contracts.
notes: 2026-07-18 completed by commits 2b85bfd, 3364373, 2c214e7, and 1d44654. API v4 adds size-queryable caller-owned O(M log M) batch preflight storage while retaining the exact allocation-free compatibility fallback. Final Release covered 83/83; settled Clang18 ASan+UBSan covered 72/72; independent review found no overflow, alias, ABI, atomicity, allocation, concurrency, or worker-order defect. Batch evidence covers sizes 1, 8, 64, and 1024 plus 514-item compatibility cases, 64 concurrent calls, exact one-byte-short/capacity/overlap failures, and clean allocation audits; docs/leopard2_batch_preflight.md records the small-batch nonregression and large-batch gains.
close_reason: Scalable allocation-free batch preflight implemented, benchmarked, sanitizer-checked, and independently reviewed.

title: Reject setup output handles that alias immutable inputs
description: Public setup APIs clear output handles before reading immutable inputs. If context_out aliases leo2_context_options, codec_out aliases leo2_codec_options, or plan_out aliases the original/recovery presence arrays, the clear mutates input metadata and can change validation or create the wrong object. Before the first output write, overflow-safely describe declared readable spans and reject output-handle overlap. Preserve the documented null-on-ordinary-failure invariant; document the exceptional alias rejection where writing null would itself corrupt immutable input. Cover guard pages, near-UINTPTR_MAX spans, short/forward option prefixes, presence arrays, normal failure nulling, Release and ASan/UBSan.
notes: Integrated primary fix fad7d6e plus root follow-up 27a01ae. Context/codec/plan setup reject output-handle overlap with declared immutable option/presence spans before first write; ordinary failures retain null-on-failure, while overlap or arithmetic-unrepresentable spans leave the handle untouched. Root follow-up validates the minimum size_t prefix arithmetic before dereferencing struct_size and adds near-UINTPTR_MAX option-prefix cases. Coverage includes exact/forward-extension/v1-adjacent aliases, presence arrays, guard pages, ordinary nulling. Agent GCC Release 2/2 and Clang ASan+UBSan 2/2; root Release focused 2/2 and ASan+UBSan ABI 1/1, diff check clean.
close_reason: Setup self-clobber bug fixed, prefix arithmetic hardened, and focused sanitizer/ABI gates pass in fad7d6e + 27a01ae.

title: Reject shard descriptor arrays that alias writable scratch or outputs
description: Manual API pass reproduced silent wrong parity: leo2_encode accepts original/recovery pointer arrays located inside caller scratch; ValidateEncodeBuffers writes AddressRange entries over those descriptors and execution then consumes corrupted pointers (GF8 K=4,R=2,64B returned success with mismatching parity under ASan/UBSan). Decode has the same second-pass scratch overwrite and restored metadata may alias writable regions. Define descriptor-array spans and lifetime precisely; reject overlap with scratch and writable outputs before mutating scratch; cover encode/decode/plan/batch, partial overlaps, guard pages, tails and sanitizers. Coordinate cross-item rules with .14.3.
notes: Integrated in 263c953. Reproduced pre-fix K=4/R=2 scratch-resident pointer-array case returned SUCCESS with wrong parity. Encode/decode now describe original/recovery/restored pointer-array spans overflow-safely before scratch mutation, reject metadata versus scratch/writable outputs, retain immutable sharing, and protect the entire batch-item array. Tests cover descriptor arrays versus scratch/output, near-UINTPTR_MAX spans, batch metadata, multi-output corruption, and exact parity/recovery after rejection. Agent: GCC13 Release, Clang18 ASan+UBSan, Clang18 TSan public API; focused Release and reduced-field matrices pass. Root after integration: full Release 69/69 and focused ASan+UBSan 6/6.
close_reason: Metadata clobber correctness bug fixed and validated in 263c953.

title: Run authoritative Leopard1-centric full CPU benchmark matrix
description: Run the plan-required production CPU matrix after source freeze: exact Leopard main versus Leopard2 direct/generic/Algorithm4/Algorithm5/AUTO across 64 B..16 MiB, low/balanced/high/padding counts, loss counts, setup and reuse 1/8/64/1024, batch dimensions, scalar/SSSE3/AVX2, code/table/scratch footprint, operation counts, and available PMU/cache/TLB/bandwidth counters. Use isolated pinned ABBA measurements with confidence intervals; split thread/NUMA scaling to .23; report unsupported exact-main R>K cells explicitly. This replaces broad external-library completion as the CPU release evidence gate.

title: Implement static topology-aware batch and NUMA scheduling
description: The current persistent pool uses dynamic atomic fetch-add and no worker affinity. Implement static scheduling for regular batch/transform work, per-worker scratch ownership, detected allowed-CPU topology, optional affinity, first-touch allocation, NUMA-node stripe partitioning, and per-node state where cross-node writes hurt. Preserve caller control and deterministic errors; do not pin unexpectedly unless requested. Validate TSan, oversubscription, cpusets, heterogeneous item costs, 1..available scaling, and external 128-core/multi-NUMA when available.

title: Build production existing-path dispatcher and crossover table
description: The production dispatcher currently uses a few narrow thresholds and does not generally model available parity, loss shape, shard size, backend, or thread/batch execution class. Build an offline deterministic crossover table for existing production direct/generic/Algorithm4/Algorithm5/materialized/tiled/pruned paths keyed only by runtime facts with defined semantics: K,R,parent,loss pattern, shard bytes, field, backend, available parity, thread budget, and evidence-backed single-versus-multiple batch class. Exact batch count and plan reuse remain benchmark/reporting dimensions under decision .38.4.2, not V1 caller hints. Validate held-out exact-main and neighboring cells; no online first-call benchmarking; profile/wire identity must remain CPU-independent. Keep exact-profile research in C10 separate.
notes: 2026-07-18 decision .38.4.2: do not add V1 expected-reuse or persistent exact-batch-count fields. Exact item_count is already a call input to scheduling; per-item decode scratch stays bounded by the ordinary plan query; immutable plans can be shared across different realized reuse. Retain reuse/exact batch as evidence axes and require an additive versioned plan-options API if future setup evidence justifies a promise.

title: Make batch cross-item aliasing deterministic and safe
description: Plan/API audit found encode/decode validate scratch/input/output disjointness only within each batch item. Two items may reuse writable scratch/output or overlap another item input; this executes sequentially with thread_count=1 but races/corrupts under a pool, making behavior machine-dependent. Define cross-item alias rules precisely, permit shared immutable inputs, reject every unsupported writable overlap before starting work, keep lowest-index error deterministic, and avoid unbounded hot-path allocation (use bounded caller/context metadata or a size-queryable batch preflight design). Cover unequal shard sizes, tails, item_count boundaries, shared inputs, duplicate scratch/output, partial overlaps, scalar/pool/TSan.
notes:
2026-07-18 integrated cb821e3 and 4e7206e on codex/leopard2. Batch encode/decode now perform a read-only addressability/metadata phase followed by allocation-free whole-batch alias preflight before any item executes; shared immutable inputs remain legal, every writable output/scratch overlap is deterministic LEO2_OVERLAP, later ordinary errors cannot partially execute earlier items, metadata-overlap rejection preserves every scratch byte, and no-loss batch remains a true no-op. Evidence: implementation branch full Release 61/61; strict Clang -Werror 2/2; ASan+UBSan 2/2; TSan 2/2. Root current focused Release passed, then commit 46a? adds 257-item decode plus encode boundary coverage in both thread_count=1/4 contexts and passes. O(B^2*(K+R)) fallback complexity is explicit; scalable caller/context metadata is follow-up leopard-79h.14.5.
Correction to the preceding shorthand: the root large-batch encode+decode regression commit is exactly 9dbb2bd; its focused Release CTest passed 1/1 at current HEAD.
close_reason: Cross-item alias behavior is now defined, preflighted atomically without hot allocation, regression-tested across scalar/pool/tails/metadata/large counts, and clean under Release, strict warnings, ASan+UBSan, and TSan. Scalable preflight performance is separately tracked by .14.5.

title: Cache permanent puncture contribution for dense active locator setup
description: Codec setup currently caches permanent locator evaluations only when sparse-direct construction is preferred. Dense active-N Walsh plans call PrepareDecode on the combined permanent+dynamic+virtual erasure mask each time, contrary to the plan's permanent-contribution reuse requirement. Derive and cache the dense active-Walsh permanent contribution (or equivalent transform-domain state), combine dynamic erasures without changing locator derivatives/reveal factors, and prove exhaustive GF4/GF8 plus broad GF16 add/remove/swap/puncture/virtual-erasure equality, concurrency, setup memory and crossover before production use.
notes: Resolved as a tested negative rather than adding a dominated dense cache. Deterministic survivor selection retains exactly K of K+R transmitted coordinates, so every plan has exactly R non-permanent real+virtual erasures; codec setup's IsDirectLocatorPreferred(N,R) therefore predicts the sparse/direct region exactly. Existing sparse permanent cache saves p*(N-1) additions. Both executable dense candidates (coordinate-domain and post-kernel transform-domain) retain two active-N Walsh transforms and N products while adding N modular additions and N persistent symbols, so union-Walsh strictly dominates. Integrated commits 0e60ca8 and 616eff5. Root Release locator replay: 9,894,532 entries, 9,647 exact-R selection patterns, 256 concurrent shared-base preparations, structural cases at N=2..65536. Worker gates: GCC13 strict Werror 3/3, Debug assertion 3/3, Clang18 ASan+UBSan 3/3, TSan locator pass. Full derivation and reproduction in docs/leopard2_permanent_locator_cache.md.
close_reason: Dense cache rejected by proved operation/pass dominance; existing sparse policy proven complete and guarded by exhaustive tests/debug invariant.

title: Serialize legacy and Leopard2 global initialization
description: Manual audit found leo_init()/leo_init_ unsynchronized: legacy m_Initialized, FF8/FF16 initialization flags/table allocation and backend SelectedOps/qualification state can be read/written concurrently. Leopard2 EnsureInitialized serializes only Leopard2 callers, not a direct legacy leo_init racing context creation. Make the full public initialization boundary process-thread-safe and idempotent with safe publication, preserve version/error/failure behavior, and add high-contention legacy/Leopard2 mixed initialization plus TSan/failure-injection coverage.
close_reason: Commit d121481 serializes the full process initializer, publishes readiness with release/acquire, keeps invalid-version/failure retries non-poisoning, and routes every Leopard2 context setup through the same boundary. Fresh mixed 64-thread legacy/context regression passes integrated Release and TSan (setarch plus documented libomp suppression); audited ASan+UBSan and reduced-field builds also pass.

title: Integrate C1 exact-mask pruning into low Algorithm 4
description: High Algorithm 5 now consumes immutable C1 plans, but production low Algorithm 4 still uses only per-block input prefixes plus the legacy output-dependency bitfield. Compile exact sparse selected-coordinate input masks and requested-original output masks during decode-plan setup, route tiled/materialized GF8/GF16 Algorithm 4 through audited pruned schedules, and test direct-oracle equality, tails, concurrency, sanitizers, setup/footprint and exact-main/neighbor crossovers before dispatch.
notes: Integrated production exact-mask Algorithm 4 pruning in a492648 with documentation in 122d7de. Plan-owned immutable low input/output schedules drive GF8/GF16 materialized and tiled kernels; mature prefix/dependency transforms remain fallback. Agent evidence: strict Clang18 focused 3/3; Release focused core 6/6 and final 3/3; ASan+UBSan focused 6/6 and final 3/3; direct_symbols=18240, plan_exec=24, batch=8, concurrent=64, tails/guards/aliases/rebuild; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 contexts; modeled schedule operations 3696 to 3330. Root current candidate: Release 68/68 excluding separately repaired portable audit, portable 1/1 after 2113a64, focused ASan+UBSan 22/22. Keep open: isolated authoritative crossover/promotion timing and committed raw evidence remain required; shared-host timings are not promotion evidence.

title: Prune sparse requested parity outputs in production encoders
description: High V1 computes a transform prefix through the highest requested parity and Low V1 computes a prefix within each requested parity block, so sparse null-output masks still execute unused butterflies and temporary writes. Add allocation-free planned exact output-mask pruning (or a reusable immutable encode-output plan) for GF8/GF16 high and low encoders, preserving every parity byte, arbitrary tails, requested-subset semantics, backend determinism and no hot-path allocation. Measure setup separately and promote only regions beating mature prefix kernels without neighbor regression.
notes:
2026-07-18 exact sparse-output substrate integrated at d61940d + 0777fd5. It compiles packed two-bit call-local schedules, handles one-row output masks, immutable-source low-rate evaluation, GF8/GF16, tails, bounded 64-KiB scratch and safe prefix fallback. Independent root review accepted the butterfly algebra/traversal and Release 70/70 passed after integration. AUTO deliberately remains on mature prefix transforms; keep this P0 open for setup-inclusive same-source crossover timing, deterministic promotion thresholds, and production-mode activation only where evidence beats prefix without neighbor regression.
2026-07-18 setup-inclusive benchmark support integrated at d8e6736 + 72a846b. The same-binary harness separates schedule setup, mature-prefix execution, prepared exact execution, and call-local compile+execute; verifies parity, models reuse 1/8/64, and records structural counts. Its fail-closed runner binds relevant sources, dirty/SHA state, executable, stdout/stderr, CPU/worker/taskset and isolation attestation. Schema/adversarial smokes and a non-authoritative 16-cell screen passed; AUTO remains unchanged pending valid isolated crossover evidence.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Independent current-root audit at 481d46f corrected the status: exact GF8/GF16 sparse kernels and tests are real, but public production AUTO plumbing is absent. Production EncodeLayout reserves no schedule suffix; PrepareSparseEncodePlans is a no-op outside hooks; normal leo2_encode passes an empty view. Existing artifacts are stale/hook-contaminated and no current-root authoritative result exists. Children .26.4.1 (pairwise ABBA/provenance/independent digests) and .26.4.2 (conditional production scratch plumbing or separate immutable encode-plan API) now capture the gap. AUTO must remain prefix until setup-inclusive call-local evidence and public end-to-end gates pass.

title: Remove Algorithm 5 coefficient-block copies and fuse recovery scatter
description: Production high Algorithm 5 still memcpy-copies all T evaluator/coefficient shards into a tile or output block before each requested block transform, then runs a separate inverse-locator multiply/scatter. Reuse the audited immutable-source out-of-place butterfly layer to evaluate from the accumulator without a whole-T copy, and evaluate fusion of the final layer with scatter and output factors. Cover materialized/tiled GF8/GF16, exact sparse output plans, tails, aliases, concurrency, operation counts and exact-main crossover; retain fallback when fusion loses.
notes: 2026-07-18 integrated commits 4dcd887 and 299ab72 on codex/leopard2. High Algorithm 5 now evaluates immutable T-coefficient sources directly through out-of-place root butterflies for prepared/materialized/tiled GF8/GF16 and exact sparse plans; the previous per-output-block whole-T copy remains only as a validated fail-safe fallback. Structural counters require zero fallback; reveal scatter fusion was evaluated and not promoted because the common public gather must retain compact GF16-tail and alias semantics. Root validation at 299ab72: GCC Release full 69/69; Clang/GCC ASan+UBSan focused 10/10; implementation-agent strict Clang18 10/10 and full Release 69/69. Keep in_progress until isolated same-source exact-main/copy-on/copy-off crossover evidence is collected; no authoritative timing was claimed on the shared host.

title: Harden legacy count validation and work-count overflow
description: Manual audit proved leo_encode_work_count/leo_decode_work_count violate their documented zero-on-invalid contract (including zero K and R>K), and leo_decode_work_count(UINT_MAX,2) wraps before NextPow2 then reaches LastNonzeroBit32(0)/__builtin_clz(0) UB. Legacy encode/decode K=1/R=1 shortcuts also bypass documented K+R<=65536 validation. Centralize overflow-safe count checks while preserving valid work counts, legacy result classes, wire output, and supported fast paths; add boundary/reduced-field/sanitizer regressions.
close_reason: Commit fa1410e (source b0ac784) centralizes overflow-safe legacy geometry, rejects zero/R>K/K+R>65536/dyadic-parent overflow/UINT_MAX before pointer traversal, and makes fast paths enforce the computed work geometry. Valid boundary work counts and legacy result classes are covered. Integrated Release public_api_contract, field_options and Leopard2 API tests pass; dual/reduced-field and Clang18 ASan+UBSan gates passed in the audited worktree.

title: Fix legacy K=1 no-loss decode null-parity crash
description: Manual whole-codebase audit reproduced leo_decode(buffer=64,K=1,R=1) with original[0] present and recovery[0] NULL passing availability validation, then entering the K==1 shortcut before the no-loss path and memcpying recovery_data[0]. Correct legacy no-loss semantics must copy/preserve original[0] into work[0] without reading absent parity. Add regression coverage across fields/count boundaries and sanitizer validation without changing legacy wire/error behavior.
close_reason: Commit cdf2211 (source 1b26020) moves legacy no-loss handling before the K=1 parity shortcut, eliminating the null recovery memcpy while preserving recovery and NeedMoreData cases. Regression covers dual-field public API plus FF8-only/FF16-only builds. Integrated public_api_contract, field_options and Leopard2 API tests pass; Clang18 ASan+UBSan focused tests passed in the audited worktree.

title: Remove R=1 and one-output hot-path setup overhead
description: Exact-main all-K diagnostics expose severe R=1 and one-loss gaps. Leopard2 sorts/merges every input range even for one output and routes padded-side-one copy/XOR through transform-sized scratch/layout plumbing. Add a linear one-output overlap validation and direct range-only single-side encode/decode layouts without weakening aliases, tails, field layouts, forced diagnostic modes, or error behavior.
acceptance_criteria: R=1 encode and one-loss decode use range-only scratch and no transform staging in production AUTO; one-output validation is linear and exact; GF8/GF16, arbitrary tails, aliases/overlaps, K=1, large K, concurrency and forced diagnostic modes pass; exact-main pinned cells show a credible improvement without neighboring regression.
close_reason: Commit 8f24962 adds range-only padded-side-one encode/direct XOR-copy decode layouts and exact linear one-output overlap validation. Focused Release 4/4, ASan+UBSan 4/4, TSan 3/3 with documented libomp suppression passed. Explicit input/output and recovery/output overlap regressions pass. Pinned directional K=129/R=1/4KiB versus untouched 2fce390 improved encode 4.116->3.578us (13.1%) and decode 5.264->3.775us (28.3%); parity/round-trip digests match. Exact main remains 6.6%/8.4% faster, tracked by .38.1. Scratch fell to 2112/4160 bytes and no longer scales with shard bytes.

title: Generalize balanced full-loss decode crossover beyond K=128
description: Current AUTO selects generic decode only for exact GF8 K=R=128 full loss, while diagnostics at K=15,16,30,31,32 show generic is about 17-21 percent faster than specialized at 64 KiB and usually about 20 percent faster at 4 KiB. Build a full rate/loss/size/backend crossover map, optimize residual generic/API overhead versus Leopard1, and extend deterministic dispatch only across supported evidence-backed regions.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned exact-main and forced generic/specialized comparisons cover power boundaries and neighbors, fields, backends, shard sizes, partial/full loss and reuse; AUTO selects the faster validated kernel; selected-path tests lock every threshold; no cell promoted from saturated diagnostics alone; correctness/wire/scratch/sanitizer gates pass and target cells beat Leopard1 or retain an explicit root cause.
notes:
2026-07-18 checkpoint f6dee1f fuses inverse-locator reveal and public scatter for the retained GF8 generic decoder only on SSSE3/AVX2 aligned prefixes >=4 KiB. The exact factor/coordinate arithmetic is unchanged; small prefixes, scalar/NEON, GF16, and tails retain scratch reveal. Same-host diagnostic before/after screens found about 11% SSSE3 and 26% AVX2 reduction at 4 KiB and larger wins at 64 KiB; an unconditional 256-byte AVX2 prototype regressed, so the committed threshold retains the old path there. Evidence: Release 70/70; focused GCC ASan+UBSan 5/5; GF8-only/GF16-only builds; OMP1/4 explicit backend tests; independent source/assembly review clean. Keep open for the full boundary matrix, independently linked exact-main result, and generalization beyond K=128.
2026-07-18 source/correctness family audit integrated at 5cd7eaa + 5371fd6 (worker 2f29ae4/46de7a7). All K=R=5..128 GF8 full-loss geometries now test AUTO, generic, materialized Algorithm5 and tiled Algorithm5 equivalence, ragged 193-byte execution, scratch boundaries 193/256/4097, and one-shot capacity. Worker gates: Release 69/69, GCC13 strict scalar API, Clang18 SSSE3 ASan+UBSan API, operation model 335. The audit derives the current-source candidate matrix and explicitly makes no dispatch/timing claim: stale saturated evidence predates exact pruning, no-copy evaluation, fused generic reveal and coarse traversal, so .38.2 remains open for isolated current-source forced-path/exact-main timing.
2026-07-18 independent audit at 190ea16 found no routing correctness bug, but current evidence is stale and selected execution paths are not authenticated. Old analyze_balanced.py can mislabel AUTO generic as specialized and must not support promotion. Split rigorous work into leopard-79h.38.2.1-leopard-79h.38.2.4: same-binary forced-path evidence, exact-main forced modes, one actual-byte-aware selector/introspection, then current-source promotion matrix.

title: Restore portable runtime-dispatched transform throughput versus Leopard1 main
description: The initial partial 1,853-cell attribution population measured exact-main/current-tree-legacy medians 0.891 encode and 0.919 decode. The later committed complete 2,760-cell all-K diagnostic measured 0.891 encode and 0.926 decode; both point to the same broad portable-backend loss. Isolate baseline control-flow and per-butterfly out-of-line Ops costs versus main whole-translation-unit native kernels. Move sufficiently coarse transform execution into compile-time-specialized SSSE3/AVX2 backend boundaries or an equivalent safe design, while preserving pre-dispatch ISA safety and per-context backend selection.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh exact-main/current-legacy/Leopard2 attribution across all GF8 K and representative GF16 identifies causal kernel costs; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 remain isolated and wire-identical; strict/static-ISA/sanitizer/concurrency gates pass; promoted coarse-grained kernels credibly beat exact main by at least 5 percent in their target regions with no unexplained neighbor regression over 2 percent, or each residual region has a concrete measured follow-up.
notes: 2026-07-18 coarse portable backend boundary integrated at 89662d0 with evidence/tooling through 3ab99ba. Compile-time scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 operations coarsen transform dispatch while preserving per-context runtime selection and wire identity. Validation before/after integration: Release 73/73, focused ASan+UBSan 5/5, strict/field/backend matrices on the source branch. Independently linked exact-main evidence shows high decode gains about 1.68-3.83x, while encode remains 6-20.5% slower and balanced GF8 full-loss about 23% slower; these residuals stay in .38.2/.38.5. The matched-parent retry was rejected after 36 external non-idle sibling jiffies; no ratios were promoted and privileged/cgroup isolation remains required for an authoritative rerun.

title: Independent final bug review and clean repeat pass
description: After prior fixes integrate, conduct an independent source review plus a fresh repeat of the highest-yield strict/sanitizer/fuzz/boundary gates without relying on earlier results. Look specifically for regressions introduced by fixes and for correlated blind spots in earlier passes.
acceptance_criteria: An independent reviewer audits the final diff and major untouched risk areas; a fresh clean-tree repeat pass finds no unresolved actionable defect; all review findings are fixed/tested or retained as explicit open bug Beads.

title: Sanitizer fuzz differential and build-matrix bug pass
description: Run ASan/UBSan, TSan concurrency, MSan when supportable, deterministic stress, public-API and pruned-plan fuzzers with distinct seeds, scalar/direct/generic/specialized/backend differential checks, and optional/reduced-field/install/build matrices. Minimize and fix every reproducible defect with a regression test.
acceptance_criteria: All applicable sanitizer, fuzz, differential, and build-matrix jobs complete on current integrated source with logged seeds and commands; every crash, race, UB report, mismatch, or optional-build failure has a child bug Bead and resolution; external blockers are exact and reproducible.
notes: Independent dynamic pass on ce059d8: Release 62/62; feasible ASan+UBSan 61/61; feasible TSan 46/46; 11 concurrency tests x20; forced backend matrix all variants; 3,000,000 ASan/UBSan fuzz inputs; 450,512 MSan core replays; reduced fields and CUDA-default graphs clean. No codec memory/race/UB/differential defect found. Harness defects tracked/fixed by child .40.3.1. Later integrated bug fixes require final clean repeat under .40.4.
close_reason: Dynamic sanitizer/fuzz pass completed with recorded evidence

title: Strict compilers and static-analysis bug pass
description: Build the complete supported target graph with strict GCC and Clang diagnostics and run available static analyzers such as clang-tidy and scan-build/cppcheck where useful. Triage every diagnostic against actual runtime and portability contracts, fix confirmed bugs with regression tests, and retain justified suppressions narrowly.
acceptance_criteria: Strict dual-compiler builds complete for production and test graphs; available analyzers cover all first-party C/C++ sources; every actionable diagnostic is fixed and tested; remaining diagnostics are documented as false positives or external/tool blockers.
notes: Independent strict pass: GCC13 and Clang18 full graphs 65/65 each after submodule init; GF8-only/GF16-only 2/2 per compiler; portable ISA 1/1 per compiler; tests-off install/archive clean; public C/C++ headers 4/4; Clang analyzer and GCC -fanalyzer found no further actionable defects; focused Clang ASan+UBSan public API clean. Child .40.2.1 fixed benchmark metadata UB. The independently duplicated K=1 legacy crash was already fixed by .40.1.1.
close_reason: Strict compiler and static-analysis pass completed

title: Manual invariant and API bug audit
description: Audit public/legacy APIs, counts and overflow, object ownership/lifetimes, aliases, scratch/layout arithmetic, field/profile identity, coordinate maps, error paths, no-op/direct/specialized/generic dispatch, immutable concurrency, and all hot-path allocation assumptions. File each confirmed defect before fixing it and add focused regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Review every production translation unit and public header; exercise boundary and malformed inputs; all confirmed findings have child bug Beads, fixes, and focused tests; a second manual pass over modified code finds no remaining actionable issue.

title: Design versioned odd-byte GF16 tail profile
description: The current GF16 symbol/wire representation cannot provide a universal fixed-B-byte MDS contract for odd B; commit d748620 documents the counterexample and safely supports every positive even length. Define the explicit new mathematics/API/wire identity needed for odd byte tails, comparing padded wire storage, GF8-hybrid final-byte coding, and paired-stripe semantics. Implement the selected versioned profile or revise the public contract with a proof-backed limitation. Never silently change legacy_high_v1 or low_v1.
design: Select LEO2_SHARD_LAYOUT_GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1. For odd application payload B, every systematic and parity coordinate physically stores W=B+1 bytes. Systematic packing is payload||0; parity byte W-1 is generally nonzero and must be transmitted. Core arithmetic remains the existing compact even-byte GF16 V1 at W bytes, so high/low profile, coordinate map, field representation, codec coefficients, and plan locators do not change. The layout is explicit codec identity and never AUTO-selected. Existing native/even behavior stays byte-identical. Reject hybrid as a general solution because its GF8 component is MDS only in a GF8-limited coordinate region; keep paired stripes experimental because they change recovery to K jointly received pairs.
acceptance_criteria: A source-backed design selects or rejects each candidate; serialized profile/field identity and exact shard-storage semantics are specified; direct algebra proves systematic/MDS behavior for the selected construction; byte sizes 1..65 and 1023..1025 pass direct differential, guards, ASan and UBSan under the new identifier; legacy/even-byte outputs remain bit-identical; migration and incompatibility are documented.
notes:
2026-07-16 research disposition: padded physical storage is the only small construction preserving the single-codeword any-K-coordinate contract for every GF16-legal K,R. Hybrid adds no current AUTO coverage and cannot exceed a proven GF8 count bound; paired stripes require identical/joint erasure semantics. Implement as a framing layout around existing even-byte GF16 with payload-to-wire query and allocation-free pack/unpack, plus identity/mismatch and direct-oracle tests. Claim is intentionally active despite the inherited public-API blocker because the isolated versioned framing work can proceed; final API freezing remains gated on leopard-79h.10.
Closure evidence commit db8b6fa: explicit fixed-width GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 layout, B-to-W=B+1 query, overlap-safe allocation-free systematic pack/unpack, critical fail-closed L2ID identity, and native/even compatibility docs. Independent direct GF16/MDS coverage: 144 payload cases, 22,096 direct symbols, 446 restored shards, 448 basis recoveries; high/low specialized, generic, AUTO transform and direct-repair paths; batch/concurrent/guard/unaligned/overflow/pad/API-v1/short-enum ABI cases. Fresh Release 18/18 and CUDA-optional 1/1; GCC ASan+UBSan 18/18 plus focused 4/4; TSan focused padded/concurrent/ABI passed under setarch; C/Python identity 186 direct checks, 81 malformed and 20,000 mutations. auto/scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 source fingerprint 076d16f953d643485dcdd1ab084f887c572ff2558f715380cee7236c511c5d58 produced identical outputs. Independent review found no remaining correctness, ABI, wire, alias, no-loss, identity, dispatch, or concurrency blocker.
close_reason: Versioned padded-odd GF16 physical layout is implemented, independently reviewed, sanitizer/backend validated, documented, and committed in db8b6fa; the broader API parent remains separately gated.

This makes supported parallel quality gates nondeterministic and masks real failures.

title: Add reversible same-user affinity isolation for authoritative benchmarks
description: Exact-main ABBA correctly rejects any reserved-sibling work, but the runner only moves itself off the pair. On 2026-07-18 a 40-cell CPU14/30 campaign and repeated CPU4/20 and CPU6/22 shards were invalidated by 1-56 non-idle sibling jiffies from unrelated same-user threads despite coordinator messages. Add a reusable unprivileged supervisor that records every controllable same-UID thread affinity, removes the reserved pair before counters start, ensures descendants inherit housekeeping masks, launches the audited runner with the declared full affinity, restores every surviving thread exactly on success/failure/signal, and records move/restore failures without weakening the zero-jiffy gate. It must not touch other users or require root.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover disappearing/reused TIDs, empty-mask rejection, permission failure, signals, descendant inheritance, exact restore, and concurrent runner leases. A real short campaign records the moved/restored thread set and passes the existing zero-nonidle verifier; any move/restore uncertainty fails closed. Failed campaigns retained on 2026-07-18 remain diagnostics, never performance evidence.

title: Evaluate sparse direct XOR-convolution locator rows
description: For sparse decoder error-root sets, evaluate replacing even the folded locator FWHT with contiguous precomputed rows for the exact identity error_log[i] = sum LogLUT[i XOR root] modulo 255. Compare a 64-KiB immutable row table, smaller on-the-fly permutations, complement symmetry, and size/root-count thresholds without changing the free-scale objective or payload circuits.
acceptance_criteria: Independent basis and deterministic-mask proofs cover every n and canonical 0/255 residue; immutable initialization and fallback are thread-safe and bounded; cold/warm cache cost, 64-KiB footprint, code size, thresholds by n/root count, and full 64-byte through 1-MiB end-to-end effects are reported. Promote only if counterbalanced timing beats folded FWHT without harmful cache regressions; otherwise document and reject.

title: Decide and harden legacy leo_* address-span preconditions
description: Independent span audit found that legacy leo_encode/leo_decode validate top-level null/count/size inputs but then index pointer arrays and process shard ranges without rejecting address arithmetic that wraps uintptr_t. Determine the documented legacy caller precondition and whether representability checks can be added without changing valid behavior or materially regressing Leopard1-compatible hot paths. Keep this separate from Leopard2's stronger robust-rejection contract.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy contract and compatibility impact are explicit; pointer-array and shard-span wrap cases have focused tests or a documented caller-precondition disposition; any promoted checks preserve old valid outputs/error codes and pass exact-main performance/nonregression plus sanitizer gates; no claim of complete pointer validity is made from arithmetic checks alone.
notes:
2026-07-18 candidate disposition: add constant-time numeric span checks for the top-level original/recovery/work pointer arrays before any array-element read, while explicitly documenting actual pointer-array accessibility and shard object bounds as caller preconditions that integer arithmetic cannot prove. Deliberately rejected an O(K+R+work) shard-address prepass: it would affect Leopard1-compatible short-shard hot paths yet still could not establish C object validity. Focused Release 8/8 and Clang18 ASan+UBSan 3/3 passed, including five new aligned near-UINTPTR_MAX array-span regressions. Keep in_progress for independent source review, full clean gates, and finalized exact-main nonregression evidence.
Coordinator full current-source Release regression after the candidate passed 84/84 with 28-way execution. The task remains open: this does not substitute for independent source review or the exact-main performance gate.

title: Reject unrepresentable Leopard2 scalar-output spans
description: Independent whole-tree span audit found that six stable Leopard2 scalar-output queries check only non-null and then immediately write zero through a size_t or uint64_t pointer: wire shard size, encode scratch, encode batch preflight scratch, decode-plan scratch, decode-plan batch preflight scratch, and one-shot decode scratch. A near-UINTPTR_MAX non-null pointer can reach undefined behavior or fault before validation. Validate the complete output object span before the first write, consistently with setup handle outputs; cover the test-only encode-path scalar output too.
acceptance_criteria: Every stable scalar-output query rejects an unrepresentable output-object span before writing; ordinary failure still clears a representable output to zero; successful values and ABI remain unchanged; focused malformed-pointer tests, Release, strict builds and ASan/UBSan pass; repeat span audit finds no analogous stable Leopard2 export.
notes: Implemented one checked IsRepresentableOutput<T> path and applied it before first write in all six stable scalar queries, the test-only encode-path query, and both private DecodePathInfo helpers. Added near-UINTPTR_MAX tests for all stable queries and clarified public docs. Independent export-by-export repeat found no remaining Leopard2 pointer-output omission. Validation: Release 83/83; Clang18 ASan+UBSan 72/72; strict GCC and Clang full builds plus focused 3/3 each; git diff --check clean.
close_reason: All Leopard2 scalar-output queries now validate the full object span before writing, with complete export audit and Release/sanitizer/strict evidence.

title: Reject unrepresentable pack and unpack buffer spans

A hostile near-UINTPTR_MAX pointer can reach undefined behavior or fault instead of returning LEO2_INVALID_ARGUMENT. Validate both spans with the common range machinery while retaining documented memmove overlap semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Pack and unpack reject every unrepresentable payload/wire source or destination span before reading or writing either peer; native and padded-odd valid/in-place/overlap behavior is unchanged; focused boundary, strict compiler, ASan/UBSan and public API tests pass; a repeat review finds no analogous helper.
notes: Fixed pack/unpack to validate payload and exact wire spans with MakeRange before memmove or pad-byte access; added four near-UINTPTR_MAX rejection cases, destination non-mutation checks, and native round-trip control. Independent fix review clean. Validation: Release 83/83; Clang18 ASan+UBSan 72/72; strict GCC and Clang full builds plus focused API/padded tests 3/3 each; diff check clean.
close_reason: Pack/unpack now reject unrepresentable spans before access with boundary regressions and full Release/sanitizer/strict validation.

title: Complete native NEON backend behind immutable context Ops
description: Leopard2 still reports ARM NEON/SSE2NEON execution outside the immutable per-context Ops-table boundary, so explicit lower backend contexts are rejected on an active NEON path and native table-lookup/fused-butterfly kernels are not a production backend. Implement and qualify a native NEON Ops table without raising the baseline ISA or changing wire bytes; use SSE2NEON only as a compatibility reference, not the sole implementation.
acceptance_criteria: AArch64 builds isolate native NEON code and dispatch only after architectural capability checks; scalar and NEON contexts coexist concurrently and remain byte-identical for GF8/GF16 high/low, tails, direct/pruned/batch paths; startup KAT and allocation/failure injection are complete; strict cross-build plus native ARM Release, ASan/UBSan and available concurrency tests pass; benchmark native NEON versus translated kernels on real ARM hardware and document PMULL/SVE follow-ups separately.

Null codec already returns LEO2_INVALID_ARGUMENT deterministically; no production defect or code change.
